torch 2.11.0+cu128.nre1 - statement of changes

This wheel is the upstream PyTorch 2.11.0+cu128 wheel (https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch, BSD
3-Clause), from https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu128, with its metadata modified by NVIDIA
CORPORATION & AFFILIATES, 2026. No source file and no binary is changed.

Changes to the wheel metadata (*.dist-info):
- METADATA: each `Requires-Dist: cuda-toolkit[<extras>]` requirement is replaced by one plain
  requirement per extra on the distribution that provides it (for example cublas ->
  nvidia-cublas-cu12), with the same version specifier and environment marker.
- METADATA, RECORD and the dist-info directory name: version set to the local version
  2.11.0+cu128.nre1.
